title: brassica oleracea subvar. rupestris
intro: Brassica oleracea subvar. rupestris, commonly known as wild cabbage or sea cabbage, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The health benefits of wild cabbage include its high content of vitamins C and K, fiber, and antioxidants, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of wild cabbage include isothiocyanates, glucosinolates, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and are being studied for their potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
